verdict.rationale: OpenCode has an HTTP API: `opencode serve` exposes an OpenAPI endpoint, and a probe found an OpenAPI spec at opencode.ai/openapi.json. However, nothing in the evidence shows an interactive, explorable API reference with runnable examples. A raw OpenAPI spec and an SDK are building blocks for such a reference, not the reference itself, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
